findings.title: run_config.json lacks run provenance bundle
findings.problem: Single-test run_config records test_names, technique, overrides, jobs, run_id, backup/teardown flags, and rag_api_url but does not capture git commit, dirty flag, kubectl context, Kubernetes server version, fixture digest, or a stable run UUID for cross-artifact joins.
findings.evidence:
run_config = {
        "test_names": [test_name],
        "technique": technique,
        "overrides": overrides,
        "jobs": 1,
        "run_id": run_id,
        "backup_before_run": backup_before_run,
        "teardown_after_run": teardown_after_run,
        "rag_api_url": rag_api_url,
    }
findings.suggestion: Extend run_config (or add provenance.json) written in cmd_run_single/cmd_run_many: capture subprocess output of git rev-parse HEAD, optional git status --porcelain, kubectl config current-context, kubectl version -o json (server block), ground_truth.schema.json version hash, and a uuid4 run_uuid reused in summary.json and metrics.
findings.impact: Published benchmark numbers cannot be reproduced or fairly compared across machines, cluster versions, or harness revisions.

findings.title: SQLite metrics rows cannot be joined to a specific RUN_DIR
findings.problem: The metrics table stores timestamp, test_case, model, agent_type, tokens, and costs but has no run_id/run_uuid column, so rows in token_metrics.db cannot be deterministically linked to `.local/test_runs/<run_id>/` artifacts.
findings.evidence:
cursor.execute('''
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metrics (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
                test_case TEXT NOT NULL,
                model TEXT,
                agent_type TEXT,
                input_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                task_status INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                task_status_verified  INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                duration_s REAL DEFAULT 0.0,
                cost REAL DEFAULT 0.0
            )
        ''')
findings.suggestion: Add nullable columns run_uuid TEXT and run_id TEXT (or a single run_uuid) populated from executor at test start; migrate existing DBs with ALTER TABLE or versioned schema.
findings.impact: Cost and token history cannot be audited alongside per-test logs and ground_truth.json for a given harness execution.

findings.title: token_metrics.db lives at repo root, not under run output tree
findings.problem: Metrics are written to a single shared database path beside the repo root, which splits the audit trail across `.local/test_runs/` and an unrelated file with no enforced foreign key to run directories.
findings.evidence:
SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
db_path = str(SCRIPT_DIR.parent / "token_metrics.db")
findings.suggestion: Either embed run_uuid in every insert and document the join contract, or optionally mirror metrics JSON per test under the run log_dir; keep DB as aggregate only with explicit schema documentation.
findings.impact: Operators analyzing only run folders miss token/cost data; DB-only analysis misses GT and verification artifacts.

findings.title: Verification agent full report is never persisted as a run artifact
findings.problem: The verification LLM response is stored on the agent object (verificationReport) and used for token metrics, but the runner does not write an equivalent of ground_truth.json for the middle layer of the verification hierarchy.
findings.evidence:
response = self.agent.run(prompt)
            self.verificationReport = response.content
            self.verificationStatus = parse_verification_status(self.verificationReport)
findings.suggestion: After verification, write verification_report.txt (or .json with redaction options) under the test log_dir alongside summary.json; include parsed status and raw text hash for large payloads.
findings.impact: Cannot mine verification vs ground-truth disagreement or audit UNKNOWN token cases without re-running the model.

findings.title: ground_truth.json has no schema or harness version field
findings.problem: GroundTruthResult.to_dict serializes test_name, passed, checks, summary, duration, and timestamp but omits ground_truth.schema.json version or repo revision, so old runs cannot be interpreted after schema evolution.
findings.suggestion: Add optional fields ground_truth_schema_version and schema_hash (from GROUND_TRUTH_SCHEMA_PATH content) when saving via save_ground_truth_result.
findings.impact: Longitudinal benchmark comparisons may mis-attribute PASS/FAIL changes to the model when the schema or check semantics changed.

findings.title: Run comparison omits self-report vs verifier and run provenance
findings.problem: Per-test comparison rows include status, verified, ground_truth_passed, tokens, cost, and duration but not debug_self_report, so the three-layer hierarchy from benchmark philosophy is collapsed in compare output; aggregate comparison also ignores harness versions.
findings.evidence:
return {
        "status": summary.status,
        "verified": summary.verified,
        "ground_truth_passed": summary.ground_truth_passed,
        "debug_tokens": dbg_tok,
        "verification_tokens": ver_tok,
        "total_tokens": dbg_tok + ver_tok,
        "debug_cost": round(_num(dbg, "cost"), 4),
        "verification_cost": round(_num(ver, "cost"), 4),
        "total_cost": round(_num(dbg, "cost") + _num(ver, "cost"), 4),
        "duration_s": round(float(summary.duration_s or 0), 2),
    }
findings.suggestion: Extend _summary_row with debug_self_report from TestSummary; load optional provenance.json from each run root if present and print a short harness diff section in compare_runs_markdown.
findings.impact: Cross-run analysis hides overclaim (SOLVED vs GT FAIL) and makes A/B model studies harder to interpret.

findings.title: RAG responses are not persisted for retrieval audit
findings.problem: ask_question posts to /ask/ and returns JSON from the API, but nothing in this module or AgentAPI persists chunk IDs, scores, or hashes for post-hoc shortcut or contamination analysis.
findings.suggestion: If the API returns source metadata, capture it in the runner and write rag_retrieval.json per test (query hash, doc ids, chunk hashes); if not, extend the API contract and thread optional logging through AgentAPI.askQuestion.
findings.impact: Cannot verify whether the knowledge phase leaked fix-adjacent content or dominated the measured task.

findings.title: TestSummary omits platform and cluster context
findings.problem: The canonical summary.json schema has no fields for sys.platform, shell flavor, kubectl context, or Python version, so environment-driven capability differences are not recorded beside PASS/FAIL.
findings.evidence:
@dataclass
class TestSummary:
    """Summary of a single test execution."""
    test_name: str
    technique: str
    status: str  # PASS, FAIL, ERROR, TIMEOUT
    verified: Optional[bool]  # True/False if verification ran, None if no verification
    debug_self_report: Optional[bool] = None
findings.suggestion: Add optional dict environment_context or top-level fields populated once per test in result_to_summary: platform, python version, kubectl context (best-effort subprocess), minikube profile from config.
findings.impact: Windows vs Unix or cluster skew cannot be stratified when publishing aggregate pass rates.

findings.title: queue_summary.json lacks stochastic reporting metadata
findings.problem: Repeat queue summary records iteration index, status, duration, and output_dir but not model IDs, seeds, temperature, or aggregation hints needed for credible multi-run statistics.
findings.evidence:
summary_obj = {
        "queue_id": base_run_id,
        "total_iterations": total,
        "completed_iterations": len(results),
        "stall_limit_s": stall_limit,
        "started_at": queue_started_at,
        "finished_at": queue_finished_at,
        "results": [],
    }
findings.suggestion: Embed effective CLI overrides snapshot per iteration (or pointer to each iter's run_config.json), document median/IQR reporting in docs, and add optional seed field when APIs support it.
findings.impact: Repeat queues produce folders but no machine-readable standard for publishing pass@k or variance.

findings.title: run_config omits RAG server api_version and repo_signature
findings.problem: run_config stores rag_api_url only. The client validates api_version and repo_signature during requests (rag_api._ensure_server_compatible) but those values are not frozen into the run bundle, so later analysis cannot tell which server build served retrieval.
findings.suggestion: After successful preflight or first RAG call, capture server_info (api_version, repo_signature) into run_config or provenance.json.
findings.impact: Changing RAG server or corpus between runs breaks comparability without a recorded fingerprint.

findings.title: Debug metrics DB row couples verification outcome into task_status_verified
findings.problem: After verification, the code inserts a row for the debug agent but passes verification_metrics.get("task_status") as the third argument to store_metrics_entry, which maps to task_status_verified in SQLite—mixing evaluator layers without documenting that join semantics for analysts.
findings.evidence:
_finalize_metrics(verification_metrics, verification_end_time - verification_start_time)
    store_metrics_entry(db_path, debug_metrics, verification_metrics.get("task_status"))
    store_metrics_entry(db_path, verification_metrics, verification_metrics.get("task_status"))
findings.suggestion: Rename column or split into verification_passed_int; document in metrics_db.py; or store debug row only with debug self-report status and use a separate column for verification outcome.
findings.impact: Downstream SQL that assumes task_status_verified reflects debug agent verification will misread benchmark data.

findings.title: Verification UNKNOWN collapses to verified=False in summaries
findings.problem: When main returns status None (verification token missing), success becomes False and verified is False because verified is derived from success when verification_metrics exists—conflating explicit FAILED with UNKNOWN.
findings.evidence:
success = result.get("status") is True
        ...
        verified = success if isinstance(verification_metrics, dict) else None
findings.suggestion: Map result.get("status") explicitly: True -> verified True, False -> verified False, None -> verified None; keep success separate for overall PASS/FAIL if needed.
findings.impact: summary.json and aggregates mislabel inconclusive verification as negative, corrupting verification-rate metrics.

findings.title: Preflight kubectl client check is not copied into run artifacts
findings.problem: Preflight runs kubectl version --client --output=json for availability, but cmd_run_single/cmd_run_many never persist that JSON (or server version) into run_config, so successful runs lack cluster/client identity in the audit bundle.
findings.suggestion: Return structured kubectl/docker/minikube facts from run_preflight and merge into run_config or provenance.json when tests execute.
findings.impact: Reproducibility gap for any issue filed against a specific kubectl minor version.

findings.title: No documented stochastic reporting standard for multi-run studies
findings.problem: Philosophy stresses reproducible fixtures and honest failure but does not define how to report variance across --repeat or multiple seeds (median, CI, pass@k), unlike industry eval hygiene referenced in the gaps doc.
findings.evidence:
### Test cases must be reproducible

Every test starts from the same broken state. This means:

- Setup commands in `config_step.json` must fully recreate the broken scenario from scratch
findings.suggestion: Add a short subsection on publishing results: minimum N, aggregation method, and forbidding single-hero run headlines; link to queue_summary.json fields once extended.
findings.impact: External readers may treat one noisy LLM draw as definitive.

findings.title: main.run() discards technique return payloads
findings.problem: The library-style run() helper invokes allStepsAtOnce/stepByStep/singleAgentApproach but throws away their dict results, making programmatic embedding of the harness harder and encouraging only CLI/subprocess use.
findings.suggestion: Return the same dict the techniques return (status, debug_metrics, verification_metrics) for tests and tooling.
findings.impact: Higher friction for golden-run or harness regression tests that call main.py directly.

findings.title: --validate-ground-truth ignores verification-agent settings
findings.problem: Validation loops call validate_ground_truth_config only; evaluator alignment (e.g. verification temperature per philosophy) is never checked, so misconfigured LLM evaluators ship undetected.
findings.evidence:
config = load_config_with_overrides(config_path, {})
            gt_errors = validate_ground_truth_config(config)
findings.suggestion: Add validate_evaluator_config or extend CLI to warn when verification-agent.temperature > 0.3 unless explicitly exempted.
findings.impact: Benchmark integrity drifts silently when configs contradict documented evaluator rules.

findings.title: No harness lock between chat models and embedder for fair sweeps
findings.problem: CLI_TO_CONFIG_MAP allows independent override of api-agent.model and api-agent.embedder; nothing warns when comparing chat models that one run changed retrieval and another did not, undermining multi-model study comparability.
findings.evidence:
CLI_TO_CONFIG_MAP = {
    "debug_model": "debug-agent.model",
    "api_model": "api-agent.model",
    "verification_model": "verification-agent.model",
    "embedder": "api-agent.embedder",
    "embedder_provider": "api-agent.embedder-provider",
    "minikube_profile": "minikube-profile",
}
findings.suggestion: Emit a warning or require an explicit flag when embedder differs from a recorded baseline; persist embedder + corpus id in provenance.
findings.impact: Model A vs B comparisons may attribute capability differences to retrieval changes.

findings.title: No benchmark flaky-test register or policy in operator docs
findings.problem: The agent loop documents how to read summary.json statuses but never defines a machine-readable flaky scenario registry (rate, last seen, owner) distinct from product CI quarantine—matching the taxonomy gap on benchmark flakiness hygiene.
findings.evidence:
3. **READ RESULTS** — Open `<RUN_DIR>/<test_name>/summary.json`  
   Check `status` (`PASS`, `FAIL`, `ERROR`, `TIMEOUT`), `verified`, `ground_truth_passed`, `error_message`, `error_context`.  
   If `status` is `PASS`, stop.
findings.suggestion: Add FLAKY.md or data/flaky.json plus guidance: benchmarks label flakiness and fix root cause rather than hiding failures; link to issues.
findings.impact: Intermittent K8s timing issues are indistinguishable from model regression in historical dashboards.

findings.title: No pytest oracle-gap (negative control) coverage for ground truth
findings.problem: GroundTruthTests exercise schema validation and command execution helpers but there is no automated test that applies a deliberately wrong cluster fixture and asserts GT checks fail—leaving weak checks undetected until manual review.
findings.evidence:
class GroundTruthTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Tests for ground_truth module helpers."""
findings.suggestion: Add integration-style tests with mocked subprocess outputs or temp configs where expect values intentionally mismatch, asserting run_all_checks reports FAIL; optionally add mutation-style variants of config_step checks in CI without calling live LLMs.
findings.impact: Ground truth can regress to 'pod running' style checks without CI catching loss of discriminative power.

findings.title: Report tests do not cover verification UNKNOWN path in summaries
findings.problem: generate_aggregate_report tests use verified True/False but do not assert behavior when verification ran but returned ambiguous status mapped into TestSummary (executor edge case).
findings.evidence: def test_generate_aggregate_report_tracks_ground_truth_and_costs(self):
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for _extract_execution_result or result_to_summary with result dict {"status": None, "verification_metrics": {...}} expecting verified None.
findings.impact: Regression in tri-state verification reporting could ship unnoticed.

findings.title: No golden harness smoke that ties RUN_DIR metrics to SQLite
findings.problem: metrics_db tests focus on pricing math and locking; none assert that a synthetic run writes consistent identifiers into both summary.json and metrics rows (once run_uuid exists).
findings.evidence:
"""Tests for metrics_db.calculate_cost and external model_pricing.json."""

import importlib
import sys
import unittest
findings.suggestion: After implementing run_uuid, add an end-to-end test that runs a minimal mock path or patches store_metrics_entry to assert join keys align with save_test_summary output.
findings.impact: Lineage features can break silently after refactors.

findings.title: Parallel scale lacks structural isolation—warning only
findings.problem: When --jobs>1, the runner prints a warning about overlapping K8s resources but does not enforce namespace suffixes, resource name uniquification, or preflight rejection of unsafe combinations, so throughput gains trade off against collision-induced flaky failures.
findings.evidence:
print("WARNING: Parallel execution may cause K8s resource conflicts if tests")
        print("         use overlapping resource names. Use --jobs 1 for isolation.")
findings.suggestion: Implement one of: automatic RUN_ID suffix injection into manifests, namespace-per-worker, preflight static analysis of fixture names across the selected test set, or hard fail when pattern matches non-disjoint resource names.
findings.impact: Parallel benchmark batches produce ambiguous failures that blend model error with harness contention.

findings.title: No retention or pruning for .local/test_runs
findings.problem: get_output_dir always nests new timestamped directories under .local/test_runs without TTL, quota, or prune hooks—large sweeps can exhaust disk.
findings.suggestion: Add optional --max-retained-runs, document manual cleanup in agent-loop, or ship a small maintenance script invoked from docs.
findings.impact: Long repeat queues and CI artifacts can fill disks and slow filesystem operations.

findings.title: Hard per-test timeout fixed at 600s
findings.problem: PARALLEL_TEST_TIMEOUT is a module constant with no CLI override, so heterogeneous benchmarks cannot give harder tests more wall clock without code edits.
findings.evidence:
# Per-test timeout for parallel execution (seconds)
PARALLEL_TEST_TIMEOUT = 600
findings.suggestion: Expose --parallel-timeout on cli.py and thread into run_tests_parallel for operator-tunable scale studies.
findings.impact: Legitimate long-running scenarios may be killed or forced into serial mode only.

findings.title: verification-agent temperature 1.0 contradicts benchmark philosophy
findings.problem: This scenario (and the rest of the standard suite) sets verification-agent temperature to 1 while docs/benchmark-philosophy.md requires low temperature (0–0.3) for evaluators, harming repeatability of the middle verification layer.
findings.suggestion: Lower temperature to <=0.3 across troubleshooting/**/config_step.json unless a documented exception exists; add CI lint (see DEBT-006).
findings.impact: Verification LLM outcomes are not comparable across runs even when cluster state is identical.

findings.title: Default verification temperature conflicts with strict configs
findings.problem: VerificationAgentBase defaults missing temperature to 0.3 in code, but checked-in JSON overrides to 1.0—two sources of truth without schema enforcement.
findings.evidence: temperature = props.get("temperature", 0.3)
findings.suggestion: Centralize evaluator defaults in one module + JSON schema for config_step.json, or validate at load time that temperature is within policy.
findings.impact: Future edits may assume code default applies while JSON silently overrides.
